Name: Joja Buildings
Author: JojaIncorporated
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Once the Joja Membership is purchased, you will be able to click on the left side of the third checkout counter to access a building page and build your new Joja buildings.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip the mod into the 'Mods' folder and enjoy.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Describe the core features of your mod[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
- SMAPI
- Stardew Valley Expanded (so that Claire will function).
- Content Patcher
- Custom Builders
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
The Stardew Valley Discord Community
